text:
What to do:

  1. Choose an everyday task, e.g. brushing your teeth.
  2. Explain to the other person how to do it.
  3. While you are explaining, they should do the task. They should your instructions carefully.
  4. Watch closely what they are doing – are your instructions easy to follow?
  5. Now imagine the other person is an alien who has never brushed their teeth before, or even seen a toothbrush or sink.
  6. Explain how to do the task again, but this time make sure the instructions are something that an alien would be able to follow.
  7. While you are explaining, they should pretend to be an alien and do the task. They might get things wrong if your explanation is not clear!


Tip for Grownups:

When you are pretending to be the alien, you can pretend to misunderstand any instructions which are unclear. Your child might have to explain in a different way to help you understand!
In this activity, you will be giving someone a really clear explanation to help them do something. You need to choose an everyday task for the activity that you don’t mind doing twice!
